reason: Provides Web UI sound notifications for selected DeepSeek Harness events, including message receipt, thinking, tool invocation, and turn completion, using a host event queue and browser-side Web Audio playback.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中的消息接收、思考、工具调用和回合结束等事件播放不同提示音。
summaries.en: Plays distinct synthesized sound alerts in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI for message receipt, thinking, tool invocation, and turn completion events.

capabilities: Listens to selected DeepSeek Harness agent and tool events
Queues recent events for browser polling through a GET endpoint
Plays synthesized notification sounds in the Web UI
Uses sessionStorage to avoid replaying events after refresh
